cards.title: Request the Shamrock Re-entry
cards.leadIn: At 500' MSL, when directed by Tower, contact Corpus Departure (UHF CH 8):

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, Shamrock re-entry.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules Shamrock re-entry.

cards.source: Binder, p. 16; Manual 2-4; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slides 46, 62–65.
